cohort: 490 mothers (and 958 children) who participated in the Hellenic National Nutrition and Health Survey between 2013-2015.
finding: Maternal lower education, smoking during pregnancy, caesarean section, prematurity, and higher birth order were associated with lower odds of breastfeeding initiation and shorter breastfeeding duration.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with lower odds of breastfeeding initiation and shorter breastfeeding duration.
